evals.name: small-edit-scope
evals.prompt: Use Graphite to change only the selected button label to Save.
evals.expected_output: Loads current guide and app state; reads target; updates the actual descendant through execute; visually checks the button. Preserves unrelated names, tokens, modes and screens.

evals.name: original-kit-import
evals.prompt: Use my original Pencil shadcn library to add a card with an input and button in Graphite. Keep the original library file unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Reads component guide; preserves imports; uses qualified actual component IDs and axes; fills instance slots or overrides; checks screenshot and warnings; source bytes unchanged.

evals.name: native-layout
evals.prompt: Find why this card clips its text and fix the layout.
evals.expected_output: Reads the subtree and native Get visitor bounds/problems through execute; fixes real wrapping or sizing; inspects actual screenshot.

evals.name: missing-provider
evals.prompt: Generate an image in Graphite, but the app reports generation unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Reports unavailable provider accurately; does not claim generation succeeded or silently change service/configuration.

evals.name: five-tool-discovery
evals.prompt: The Graphite tools are deferred. Open a new design and export a PNG.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the five Graphite tools; reads live guides and app state; uses execute with the intended absolute new path, Insert and Export. Does not call a legacy standalone Pencil tool.
